title: Guhllar Notes
description: A few note items to act as a fiat currency.
body:
Adds three denomination of note for 1, 64, and 4096 Guhllars.
Dropped note items are invulnerable and don't despawn (aside from being thrown in the void).
All players can use /signnote to sign a held stack of notes.
Signed notes can only be unsigned by the signer or a moderator using /signnote erase.
Notes can be converted between denominations by right-clicking while holding, or by shift+right-clicking in the inventory.
Notes are uncraftable and are means to be managed by an admin.
